name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label for a control that shows on hover and keyboard focus, wired with aria-describedby. Escape hides it; it only fades under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: The element that gets the tip. Use a focusable one.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger the tip appears on.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before showing on hover. Focus shows it at once.
